body:
Ok, I just got back from my drug dealers house. I bought 2 grams of weed and 100mg of AMT. When I got home I took 80mg of the AMT and smoked two bowls to counter act the nausea that AMT can cause. I decided to play world of warcraft till it kicked in.
40 minutes after ingestion my vision was getting weird and I felt very different, like I was in a robot body. I got very exited and tried to continue playing my game. I had a movie in the background and the sound from it was sounding like when you talk into a strong fan, you know what I'm talking about? I knew things where about to get cool but I had no idea they would be so intense. My desk and chair I'm in start to get really tall then really short, I'm unable to play my game at this point. Then out of know where my body and desk and chair started to get flattened by an unknown force. It felt very weird and was kinda scary at first but then I just smiled and went with being flat.
Once I was flat, my feet started to move back behind my chair and loop over my head, like I was being dragged from under my chair then my legs fell over my shoulders. I looked around my room and I realized I had no idea where the fuck I was, I panicked a little. Big mistake. My mind and body were instantly transported into a whole different dimension, it was all black and I was moving so fast and had a strange pulling sensation in my stomach. My dealer texted me and the vibration of my phone brought me back to reality. I decided to get up and lay down and watch frozen planet but when I laid down I just kind blacked out. That's all I can remember.
I think AMT is a very promising chemical. I want to try it again and next time I will be more prepared for it. I had a very awesome time during the trip and strongly recommend AMT
